# IJW Labs

> IJW Labs is a digital agency based in Accra, Ghana, founded by Isaac Asamoah, Judah B. Amanor
> and Wisdom Dzanado (the I, J and W). It builds websites, custom business systems and
> professional photo edits for small and growing businesses, working remotely with clients worldwide.

## Services
- Web Development: business websites, landing pages, online stores, booking/ordering flows,
  hosting and maintenance. Mobile-first and conversion-focused.
- Systems Development: custom inventory, bookings, records, billing and reporting tools
  shaped around how a business actually runs.
- Photo Editing: product photography retouching, portraits, promotional and social media
  visuals, batch editing for catalogs.

## How it works
Clients message IJW Labs on WhatsApp (+233 53 992 3975) and receive a plan and a clear,
custom quote within 48 hours. Typical focused websites take 1-3 weeks. Post-launch support
(updates, fixes, questions) is included with every project.

## Facts
- Founded: 2026, Accra, Ghana
- Founders: Isaac Asamoah, Judah B. Amanor, Wisdom Dzanado
- Contact: WhatsApp +233 53 992 3975 (primary), Instagram @ijw_labs, X @ijwlabs, Snapchat ijwlabs
- Pricing: custom per project; budget-range friendly; no fixed price list
- Site: https://impulse69.github.io/ijw-labs-site/

## Portfolio
IJW Labs has built 19+ live hotel, lodge and guest house websites across Ghana's Eastern
Region (Koforidua, Aburi, Akropong, Kwahu, Mamfe, Atimpoku and more), including Eastern
Premier Hotel, Freden Hotel, Little Acre Hotel, Yaven Heights, Dear Home Hotel and Modak
Royal Hotel. See them at https://impulse69.github.io/ijw-labs-site/work
